answers.question: What changed in the agent's traces after you wrote your instructions? Give one claim as an example.
answers.answer: Not much changed in the results of the claims, but for the claim I spoke about in 1c, the agent did a much better job at navigating its queries. “Detail production credits song lyric "Singapore"” this query was what would have answered the claim.
